newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Four Seasons started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Four Seasons started as buy.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it started coverage of Four Seasons Hotels Inc with a buy rating and gave the stock a 1998 price target of $28.50.
-- Analysts W. Bruce Turner and Bradley Hatfield forecast 1997 EPS at $0.95 and 1998 at $1.24 for the manager of luxury hotels and resorts in a research report.

-- They cited a strong management team and said the company is well-positioned to continue expanding its international portfolio. They also said 14 hotels and resorts are under construction or contract to be managed by Four Season in six additional countries, which will add to earnings growth over the next several years.
-- cited positive fundamentals in the luxury lodging segment, especially in the United States.
